science.explanation: The Spinny Stabilizer is a novel device designed to provide stabilization in rotating systems.
assumptions: The system can be approximated as a rigid body
The stabilizer's mass is negligible compared to the system

diagrams.mermaid: graph LR; A[Spinny Stabilizer] -->|T|> B[Rotating System]; C[Stabilizer Mass] --> D[ Negligible ];
diagrams.caption: Simplified model of the Spinny Stabilizer
